messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites Java 8 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

import java.util.Scanner;

public class Solution11 {
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
		int w = sc.nextInt();
		int m = sc.nextInt();
		if(w < 4){
			System.out.println("YES");
			return;
		}
		while(m>0){
			int remainder = m%w;
			int next = m+1;
			if(remainder > 1 && remainder != w-1){
				System.out.println("NO");
				return;
			}
			m = next/w;
		}
		System.out.println("YES");
	}
}
</perturbed_code_1>
